answer.original_source: NN, Inc. (company announcement, late June 2026, relayed by finance.yahoo.com on 2026-07-01)
answer.new_information: Relays NN, Inc.'s own announcement of 47 new machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling of NVIDIA AI data center racks, with 100% of new capacity stated as pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and a targeted US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026. These are company claims with no independent verification in the text. Period and definition mismatch: the US$80-90 million is a 2026 new-business target, not a revenue forecast or result. The 2028 figures ($485.5m revenue and $47.9m earnings in the narrative; about US$489.5m and US$48.3m attributed to unnamed analysts) are third-party narrative and rumour projections with no stated basis, and the text does not link them to NVDA. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal is a fact about NN's index membership, not an NVDA question. The subject is a supplier to NVIDIA racks, not NVIDIA itself, and no stored or catalog question covers it.
answer.reason: No questions_to_consider, stored_pieces, or catalog entries exist to update, so nothing in NVDA's argument moves. The record is a supplier-level announcement carrying company-stated capacity and target figures with a promotional article around them. It is context on NVIDIA's rack supply chain, not an investment judgement that could change the NVDA position, so it does not warrant propose_new. The 2028 projections and index removal do not bear on an NVDA question. Retain as background for any future question on NVIDIA liquid-cooling supplier capacity, treating the 100% pre-sold and US$80-90 million figures as company claims pending a filing or shipment confirmation.
